pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpessanti, seyyathāpi gihikāmabhogino 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.6: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te . . . vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.8: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.9: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.12: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpessatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.13: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--;
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.14: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:1.15.1: yo pana bhikkhu suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-np12:2.16: idaṃ me bhante suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpitaṃ . . . ādikammikassā
